title: nan
authors: Xu H.; Zhao G.; Bo Y.
key_contribution: Presents an anchor-free UAV-UGV collaborative localization framework fusing VIO with UWB ranging via factor graphs with adaptive weighting and outlier suppression, validated in real-world large-scale GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
